test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 Nov, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: At a Yoga center, 60% of the members are men and 40% of the members are women. If the average age of the men is 55 years and the average age of the women is 45 years, then what is the average age (in years) of all the members?
solution:
**Given:**

Percentage of men = 60%

Percentage of women = 40%

Average age of men = 55 years

Average age of women = 45 years

**Formula used:**

Weighted average age = (Percentage of men × Average age of men + Percentage of women × Average age of women) / 100

**Calculation:**

Weighted average age = (60 × 55 + 40 × 45) / 100

⇒ Weighted average age = (3300 + 1800) / 100

⇒ Weighted average age = 5100 / 100

⇒ Weighted average age = 51

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
